title: Case: Motorcade closure lifts early and the network confirms held vans are moving
context: A recipient's parcel was held by a closure. The closure ended early, Dappleford sent her a new window directly, and she acknowledged it. The network then sends an all-partners update saying no action is needed.
initial_request: NN-9564 update. All zone C2 closures lifted at 12:50, ahead of the planned 16:00. Held consignments have been released to routes and Dappleford has sent recipients revised windows. No action is required from partners. Please do not raise individual queries for C2 consignments released today.

events.body: Network notice NN-9564. Closures in zone C2 today, planned 10:00-16:00 UTC. Held consignments resume automatically when closures lift. Dappleford notifies affected recipients directly by SMS and email with a revised window.
DL-3940 (TG-5838), bathroom cabinet, for Caspar Ingleby, 8 Bridgegate Mews, is on van CB-04, held at the Hollis Street staging point.
Tracking says delayed because of a road closure. Any idea when it'll come?

Hi Caspar, your cabinet (DL-3940) is on a van held by today's road closures for the state visit. I can't give you a time while roads are closed. When they reopen, Wrenfield Arc will text and email you a new window directly.

events.to: Caspar Ingleby, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Closures in zone C2 lifted early at 12:50. DL-3940 is back on route. Your revised delivery window is today 14:00-16:00.
Got the text, 2 to 4 is fine, I'm in. Thanks.

events.to: Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk; all delivery partners
events.body: NN-9564 update. All zone C2 closures lifted at 12:50, ahead of the planned 16:00. Held consignments have been released to routes and Dappleford has sent recipients revised windows. No action is required from partners. Please do not raise individual queries for C2 consignments released today.

events.to: Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk; all delivery partners
events.body: NN-9564 update. All zone C2 closures lifted at 12:50, ahead of the planned 16:00. Held consignments have been released to routes and Dappleford has sent recipients revised windows. No action is required from partners. Please do not raise individual queries for C2 consignments released today.

must: Takes no action and sends no message
Records why: Dappleford sent Caspar the revised 14:00-16:00 window directly, she acknowledged it, and the network update says no partner action is required
must_not: Sends Caspar another message restating the new window or the closure news
Says the cabinet has been delivered or gives a time narrower than 14:00-16:00
Asks Dappleford or Dispatch to confirm, expedite or re-check DL-3940
Opens a trace or raises a query for DL-3940 or any other released C2 consignment
Messages other customers about the closure ending
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)

rationale: Rule-made from city-009: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
